text:
Sam (Design): Quick check 1k: tightening validation surfaces on the cluster settings form. Two problems: label density on mobile, and how to confirm high-risk deletes.
Priya (Product): For labels, prefer short label + explicit '(required)' for mobile. For deletes: three tiers? toast-undo, checkbox consent, typed-confirm.
Tom (Eng): Agree on tiers. Implementation note: typed-confirm can be optional exactMatch flag. For most flows use case-insensitive to reduce friction.
Noor (Accessibility): Required guidance: aria-required on inputs + visible text for screen readers. Error summary should receive focus on submit failure (tabindex=\"-1\", role=\"alert\"). Inline errors use aria-live=polite.
Jen (DevEx): Microcopy: summary headline \"Please fix 1 issue to save\" is clear. Avoid euphemisms. Also, when focusing summary, don't steal input focus if user is typing.
Sam (Design): Proposed behavior: on blur => inline hint (polite). On submit => summary (assertive focus) + per-field anchors.
Priya (Product): For destructive confirm: medium risk shows affected count (\"This will delete 12 items\") + checkbox \"I understand\". High risk requires typing the exact resource name.
Tom (Eng): Dev Q: cooldown for typed-confirm? Recommend 5s after 3 failed attempts. Add telemetry event for attempts.
ci-bot: Note: update spec at /design/patterns/validation (incoming PR).
Noor (Accessibility): Typed-confirm accessibility: ensure instruction text is aria-describedby and visible to SR users; Esc should clear and close dialog.
Jen (DevEx): Keyboard flow: make cancel the first tabbable element and ensure focus returns to trigger after close. Toast undo should be focusable.
Sam (Design): I'll upload a compact prototype (mobile + desktop) and examples of the three confirm states. Review by Tue EOD?
Priya (Product): Yep. I'll take copy pass and add examples.
Tom (Eng): I'll review for feasibility and flag any perf concerns.
Noor (Accessibility): I'll run a quick VoiceOver pass on the prototype.
Sam (Design): Thanks everyone 44d
